definitions.explanation: Describes someone or something that is stylish, well-dressed, or has good taste in fashion and appearance.
As a noun or suru-verb, refers to the act of dressing up or paying attention to one's appearance.

examples.japanese: おしゃれなカフェを{見|み}つけた。
{彼女|かのじょ}はいつもおしゃれだ。
{今日|きょう}はおしゃれして{出|で}かけよう。
examples.english: Let's dress up and go out today.
examples.notes: おしゃれする = to dress up

notes:
Can function as a na-adjective, noun, or suru-verb.

FORMS:
・おしゃれな + noun (おしゃれな{服|ふく} = stylish clothes)
・おしゃれする (to dress up, make oneself stylish)
・おしゃれさん (a fashionable person - affectionate)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・おしゃれな{店|みせ} (stylish shop)
・おしゃれな{街|まち} (fashionable neighborhood)
・おしゃれに{気|き}を{使|つか}う (to care about one's appearance)

Can be written with kanji as {お洒落|おしゃれ}, but hiragana is more common.
